scope: One isolated browser session and one exact owned loopback SSH forward; no fixture/resource writes, no source changes, no Hub/Agent outage, no mock routes.

source_findings.fact: Dashboard query requests nodes, executions, applications, schedules and tasks via Promise.all.
A query error or missing data renders ErrorState; Retry calls query.refetch().
ErrorState exposes role=alert and Retry button.
Sidebar Dashboard route is TanStack Link to `/`; this is not a plain anchor implementation.
QueryClient sets staleTime=10s and production refetchOnWindowFocus; no source reference to explicit networkMode or onlineManager configuration.

proposed_steps: Open Dashboard normally in the dedicated authenticated session; wait for Dashboard content and record successful GETs for the five query endpoints. Do not test cold navigation again.
Verify browser remains on same Dashboard route and online; record navigator.onLine true and baseline UI/query data.
Capture exact owned SSH PID, startticks, argv digest and listener ownership. Confirm SSH -G has no extra forwards and port 38181 is owned only by this session.
Terminate only that exact owned SSH forward with a process identity guard; leave browser online and keep Dashboard mounted. Confirm only loopback listener disappeared.
Wait at most one 15-second query interval plus a bounded margin. Capture actual same-origin Dashboard API failures and ErrorState/Retry. If no failure or no alert appears, stop and report PARTIAL.
Reconfirm 38181 is free and no shared listeners exist, start one exact owned forward, then click the actual Retry button from a fresh agent-browser snapshot ref.

Capture real GET 200 responses for the five Dashboard query endpoints, restored Dashboard content and no route reload; then logout dedicated token, close session, stop exact forward and verify listener count zero.
success_oracle: navigator.onLine stayed true throughout the injected tunnel-only fault
Dashboard remained mounted and URL did not change
one or more actual Dashboard API GETs failed while tunnel listener was absent
ErrorState role=alert and Retry action were visible
after restoring only the owned forward, user Retry produced real successful GETs and Dashboard content
stop_conditions: Any PID/startticks/argv or listener ownership mismatch
Any non-loopback or shared listener appears
Browser navigates away from Dashboard or session loses authentication
No actual Dashboard data request fails; no ErrorState after bounded interval
Cleanup cannot prove exact process ownership
limits: This tests repair-origin loopback transport failure while navigator.onLine remains true. It does not claim browser offline behavior, global network loss, or a product defect.
